## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped to one logical concern
- [ ] Tests were added or updated, or the change does not need them
- [ ] Lint and the repository's CI checks pass locally
- [ ] Documentation (README, `docs/`, help text) is updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or private data appear in the diff
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this code under the repository's licence
